summary: Investigated vitest sandbox.test.ts failures ('URL must be of scheme file') by probing import.meta.url in various locations; root cause was not confirmed in this segment, but did copy sandbox-child.cjs into extensions/workflows/src/. Then pivoted to setting up symlinks/junctions from the gizmo-registry extensions into ~/.pi/agent/extensions and ~/.pi/agent/extension-web for search-and-scrape, subagents, and workflows, updating installed.json to mark them as linked, but a smoke test importing the extensions via tsx failed because top-level await was used under the CJS output format.
decisions: Chose to copy sandbox-child.cjs into extensions/workflows/src/ alongside sandbox.ts so the worker file is resolvable when importing via import.meta.url.
Switched from PowerShell New-Item to node fs.symlinkSync for the .web.js file symlinks to bypass PowerShell's elevation check (junctions for the extension dirs were created via PowerShell).
Updated ~/.gizmo/registries/installed.json to add search-and-scrape, subagents, and workflows to the gizmo-registry 'linked' list to match app bookkeeping.
errors: All 5 spawn-related tests in extensions/workflows/src/sandbox.test.ts fail with 'URL must be of scheme file' at new URL('./sandbox-child.cjs', import.meta.url); probes showed import.meta.url resolves to a proper file:// URL in both packages/orchestration and extensions/workflows/src, so root cause was not pinpointed in this segment.
First PowerShell link script failed: PowerShell string interpolation of $ext\$id lost the backslash separator between directory and id, collapsing paths like '...extensionssearch-and-scrape'.
Second PowerShell run failed with Remove-Item because the first run had already deleted search-and-scrape.ts, subagents/, and workflows/ before failing at New-Item.
Third PowerShell run failed creating search-and-scrape.web.js symbolic link with 'Administrator privilege required' (New-Item), prompting the switch to node fs.symlinkSync which succeeded.
tsx smoke test failed: top-level await used in /tmp/smoke.ts compiled as CJS by esbuild, so it threw 'Top-level await is currently not supported with the cjs output format'.
